name: Texture Coordinate Conversion
definition: A utility function to convert local/world space coordinates (P) to texture coordinates (uv) for volume sampling. It scales by inverse volume size, adds 0.5 offset, and flips the Y axis.
summary: Texture Coordinate Conversion maps spatial coordinates to normalized texture values by scaling with inverse volume dimensions, adding a half-texel offset, and flipping the Y axis to align voxel grids with texture samplers.
